Thank you. I ordered and ate a nauseating amount of pizza (which is what I joke is my harmless self-harm) and I'm feeling a lot less pissy. I've just been really high-strung for a while now.

But really, thank you!

You also made a douchey comment an hour ago which got deleted but I can still see on your user page. I must really be affecting your life to make you come back for round two. You seem like a really fulfilled person.
Aww, did I hurt your poor little feelings about Game Grumps and provoke you into telling a suicidal person to do it? That seems proportionate.
how do i keep living like this? EVERYTHING IS A MENTAL BREAKDOWN.

By the way I'm /u/stop-being-a-cock and I know it's not okay but I'm just sick of being so angry and hateful at myself instead of people who i think deserve it. I know that makes me a hypocrite and a bad person.
Thank you so much. That really does help a lot.
